meta.title: DeepSeek Web window
meta.description: Adds a DeepSeek Web row above the sidebar balance. It opens the real chat.deepseek.com in a small window docked above that row: the user's own account, browser usage limits, no API tokens. The window has reload, open-in-browser and close controls, and a local prompt composer whose three buttons copy a shaped request (thought, agent prompt, short text) for pasting into the web chat. The embedded window exists only in the Desktop app; a browser-only Harness falls back to opening the site in a tab.
